measured_body.en: Measured performance relative to the S&P 500: a description, not a forecast or an entry call.
measured_body.zh: 相对标普500的实测表现：只是描述，不是预测，也不是入场信号。

order_footnote.en: Order = measured 3-month performance, not a recommendation.
order_footnote.zh: 排序 = 实测3个月表现，并非推荐。

breadth_body.en: Breadth tells you whether the rotation is a broad tide or a narrow few. Be selective when it is narrow.
breadth_body.zh: 广度告诉你这是全面上涨还是少数领涨。领涨面窄时应精挑细选。

tagline.en: Every basket, sortable, with a rebased chart
tagline.zh: 全部篮子，可排序，附归一走势图

confluence_body.en: Every sub-industry as its own basket, scored for entry timing. The read below is answer-first: the rotation backdrop, which groups just turned buyable, which are late or fading, and the stocks firing inside a group with the wind at its back. A timing map. Confirm before acting.
confluence_body.zh: 将每个子行业视作独立篮子，按入场时机评分。下方读数以结论优先：轮动情况、哪些子行业刚转为可买、哪些已偏晚或转弱，以及在顺风子行业中触发的个股。择时图。行动前请确认。

confluence_footnote.en: Every subsector is an equal-weight basket of its members, scored on a 3-day cadence for entry timing, not a buy list.
confluence_footnote.zh: 每个子行业为其成分的等权篮子，按 3 日周期为入场时机评分，并非买入清单。层级衡量汇聚交叉的新鲜度（T1 最新）。

rebase_footnote.en: Lines are rebased to 0% at the start of the window. Toggle baskets from the legend; “All” covers the available cache history.
rebase_footnote.zh: 曲线在窗口起点重设为 0%。可在图例中开关篮子；“全部”覆盖可用缓存历史。

versus_body.en: 1W · 1M = return · trend = heating (+) or cooling (−), the map’s vertical axis

recorded_body.en: Recorded by Mastermind at the time, not recalculated later.
recorded_body.zh: 由 Mastermind 当时记录，事后未重新计算。

intro_body.en: The 11 GICS sector ETFs on one cycle clock: real price (rebased & log, so every line shares an axis) with a one-tap cycle-position view. Peaks & troughs are auto-detected from the tape, each sector is graded by where it sits in its cycle, and clicking a leg tells you what drove the move. Projections here are windows, not certainties: re-drawn nightly as new data lands.
intro_body.zh: 11 个 GICS 板块 ETF 同处一张周期时钟：真实价格（再基准化并取对数，使每条线共用同一坐标轴），并可一键切换为周期位置视图。波峰与波谷由价格走势自动识别，每个板块按其周期所处阶段评级，点击任一区段即可了解推动该走势的原因。这里的预测是时间窗口，而非确定性结论：每晚随新数据重新计算。

hazard_footnote.en: P(next confirmed turn within horizon) for the open {direction}-leg. PASS cells passed the W4.2 calibration gate historically (isotonic-calibrated vs KM). The live feature set does not match the admitted scorer (live_feature_parity PARITY_FAILS, 15 features, measured on a038b3f3), so no cell is a current claim; sectors flagged parity_failed show the cell muted with that reason. PRIOR cells appear only when the producer emits a KM base rate. Display-only context, never a signal.
hazard_footnote.zh: 开放周期段在各时间窗内出现下一个已确认拐点的概率。PASS=历史上通过W4.2校准门槛的模型输出。当前实时特征集与已核准评分器不一致（live_feature_parity 为 PARITY_FAILS，15 项特征，测于 a038b3f3），因此任何单元格都不构成当前判断；标记 parity_failed 的板块以弱化显示并注明原因。仅当生产端输出 KM 基准率时才显示 PRIOR。仅供展示，绝非信号。

forecast_footnote.en: Projected next {turn} ≈ {month} ({low}–{high}), from this {unit}’s own median half-cycle: a descriptive rhythm, not a model, and a timing window, not a guarantee.
forecast_footnote.zh: 预计下次{turn}约在 {month}（{low}–{high}），基于该{unit}自身的中位半周期：描述性节律而非模型，仅为时间窗口。

incompatible_generation_body.en: History {x}, current read {y}. Not drawn, so the two are never mixed.

partial_body.zh: 基于 {y} 项检查中的 {x} 项

corrected_body.en: Comparison reset after a source change.
corrected_body.zh: 数据变更后，正在重新建立比较。

abstained_body.en: Forecast: none. No forecasting model has been approved for this read.
abstained_body.zh: 预测：无。此项尚无获批的预测模型。

error_body.en: The current read above is unaffected.
error_body.zh: 上方的当前读数不受影响。

empty_body.en: Events appear here once Mastermind records one.
empty_body.zh: Mastermind 记录后将自动出现。

no_access_body.en: Sign in with access to view these observations.
no_access_body.zh: 请使用有权限的账户登录查看。

offline_body.en: We cannot reach the network right now. Your changes are kept on this device and written through when it comes back.
offline_body.zh: 当前无法连接网络。更改会先保存在本机，恢复后自动写入。

unauthorized_body.en: You are signed in; this part needs a different plan.
unauthorized_body.zh: 你已登录；此部分需要其他方案。

locked_body.en: This section is withheld by its owner. The rest of the page stays available.
locked_body.zh: 此部分由其所有者保留。页面其余内容仍可查看。

invalid_payload_body.en: The source coverage could not be checked. Open the full evidence for details.
invalid_payload_body.zh: 无法核验来源覆盖情况。请打开完整证据查看详情。

zero_title.en: No names clear both gates today.
zero_title.zh: 今日无名单同时通过双门槛。

zero_body.en: Zero fill pressure: however many qualify (an empty lane is honest).
zero_body.zh: 零填充压力：合格多少就显示多少（空榜也是诚实的）。

empty_search_body.en: Nothing on the clock. Tap an item or hit Select all visible to chart them.
empty_search_body.zh: 图中暂无条目。点击任一条目或点全选可见即可绘制。

uncertain_command_body.en: It was sent, but the result is not confirmed. Nothing retries automatically. Check the record before repeating it.
uncertain_command_body.zh: 操作已发出，但结果未确认。不会自动重试。重复前请先核对记录。

grader_body.en: Realized directional hit-rate, cross-sectional rank-IC and excess-vs-SPY of the conviction calls, by horizon. Sparse until it accrues; never fed back into the live score.
grader_body.zh: 按时间跨度衡量信念判断的已实现方向命中率、横截面秩相关与超越SPY的超额收益。数据累积前较稀疏；绝不回灌入实时评分。

accruing_body.en: Accruing: dated calls are logged and will be graded against realized forward returns as time passes ({n} calls logged).
accruing_body.zh: 累积中：带日期的判断已记录，将随时间推移对照已实现的前瞻收益进行评分（已记录 {n} 个判断）。

lanes_footnote.en: Lanes are the only gated, graded calls on this page. Everything below is context, measured nightly.
lanes_footnote.zh: 操作清单是本页唯一的门控与自评分判断。下方内容均为背景信息，每晚计算。

clock_mismatch_body.en: The measurement date is later than its source page. Review the source dates.
clock_mismatch_body.zh: 实测日期晚于来源页面日期。请核对来源日期。
